power.text: An echo you kill releases a Forkline from where it stood.
Lightning chains +2. Each hop hits harder instead of weaker.
Storm Bolt splits into a Forkline on its first hit.
Whirling Cleave can be held. It drains mana while you spin.
Each enemy a Cleave form hits gives +4% attack speed for 3 s (stacks 10).
While spinning you pull enemies in, and every third turn lets out a Thunderclap.
